name: KIC 6188073
description: A red giant climbing its first giant branch in the Kepler field, 6.4 solar radii and 1.24 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 6188073 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 6.353 +/- 0.1189

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 6188073 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.2398 +/- 0.0519

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 6188073 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4593.1724 +/- 40.6244

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 6188073 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.9272 +/- 0.0041

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant in the Kepler field, 6 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.24 solar masses and 6.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,593 K at its surface.
